description: This file defines serialization, surrogate, and copying logic for the ImmutableArray<T> type in the Orleans serialization framework. It includes codec, surrogate, and copier implementations specific to ImmutableArray<T>.

classes.name: ImmutableArrayCodec<T>
classes.description: Serializer for ImmutableArray<T> using a surrogate.

classes.name: ImmutableArraySurrogate<T>
classes.description: A surrogate type used by ImmutableArrayCodec to serialize ImmutableArray<T>.

classes.name: ImmutableArrayCopier<T>
classes.description: A copier implementation specifically for ImmutableArray<T> in the Orleans serialization system.

methods.name: ConvertFromSurrogate
methods.description: Converts an ImmutableArraySurrogate<T> back to ImmutableArray<T>.

methods.name: ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Converts an ImmutableArray<T> to an ImmutableArraySurrogate<T>.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of an ImmutableArray<T>.
